brand_identity.name: Purnabramha
brand_identity.tagline: World's First Intelligent Restaurant Chain Powered by A.AI Technology
brand_identity.vibe: Elegant, sophisticated, bright luxury Maharashtrian heritage with warm golden accents on a pristine white canvas. Dark brown navigation bar with golden glossy text.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium text-[#2D1810]
rules.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-medium text-[#2D1810]

spacing_and_layout.surface_styles: Use pearl-surface class for cards. Subtle gold borders with warm pearl backgrounds. Light shadows with golden tints.

components.header: Dark brown solid: bg-[#3D2314]. Golden glossy text using nav-gold-text class. Sticky top-0 z-50.
components.buttons_primary: gold-glossy class: Gradient from #D4AF37 to #B8962E. Dark brown text. rounded-none.
components.cards: pearl-surface class: White to cream gradient bg, subtle gold border, light shadow with gold tint.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: bg-white border-[#E8DFD0] rounded-none focus-visible:ring-[#B8962E] text-[#2D1810].

css_utility_classes.pearl_surface: bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-[#FDFBF7] to-[#F8F5F0] border border-[#B8962E]/12 shadow-[0_2px_16px_rgba(184,150,46,0.06)]
css_utility_classes.gold_glossy: bg-gradient-to-b from-[#D4AF37] via-[#B8962E] to-[#A07D1A] text-[#3D2314] shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(184,150,46,0.35)]
css_utility_classes.nav_gold_text: Golden glossy gradient text for dark header navigation. Uses background-clip: text.
css_utility_classes.text_gold_shimmer: Animated gold gradient text. Use for headings emphasis.

animations.hero: Elegant fade and scale-up on load.
animations.scroll: Staggered reveal for menu items using Framer Motion.
animations.hover: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and border color transition.

hero_background.description: Light, elegant restaurant interiors or food photography with warm lighting.

hero_food.description: Premium Maharashtrian dishes on light backgrounds with golden garnish.

instructions_to_main_agent: Header uses dark brown (#3D2314) background with golden glossy text (nav-gold-text class).
Replace all dark backgrounds (#0A0505, #080404, #140A0B) with light pearl backgrounds (#FDFBF7, #F8F5F0, white).
Replace dark text (#FDFBF7) with dark brown (#2D1810).
Replace muted text (#A89F95) with warm brown (#5C4A3A or #7A6F65).
Replace dark borders (#2A151A) with soft gold-tinted borders (#E8DFD0 or rgba(184,150,46,0.12)).
Use gold-glossy class for primary CTA buttons with dark brown text.
Use pearl-surface class for card containers.
Keep the text-gold-shimmer class for heading accents.
All inputs/selects: white bg, warm border, gold focus ring.
Ensure sufficient contrast - dark text on light backgrounds.
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Maintain Cormorant Garamond for headings, Outfit for body text.
